purpose: Human cardiomyocyte single-cell/single-nucleus source for the Stage 2 gene axis (ADR 0066): the CM-only cellxgene object of the Reichart et al. cardiomyopathy collection. The object's donors are split by Primary.Genetic.Diagnosis: genotype-negative DCM donors supply the nHF CM-pseudobulk evidence, while genotype-positive DCM and the 8 ARVC donors are exported (single NCCM donor excluded) as the tracked compact per-donor pseudobulk + genotype table ticket #188 uses for genetic_cardiomyopathy. Ticket #188 derives the two genetic_cardiomyopathy contrasts (genotype-positive DCM vs normal, ARVC vs normal) in script/build_genetic_deg.py from that tracked export, read-only; the pseudobulk is not re-derived and #187's tracked DEG summary/table are untouched.

Tracked compact export and the input ticket #188 uses.

notes: OBJECT IDENTITY: the item is named by its collection/object identity (as pert_data/DToxS-iPSC is), because it is not a GEO series. Collection e75342a8-0f3b-4ec5-8ee1-245a23e0f7cb, dataset version 27fdbdf9-deae-4aed-bf7f-21964ee62137, title 'DCM/ACM heart cell atlas: Cardiomyocytes', 311,418 cells, 32,383 features, schema 7.1.0. GATE: obs cell_type has exactly one category, 'cardiac muscle cell' (the object is CM-only), so every cell is gated in; the pseudobulk assumes no re-clustering. COUNTS: raw/X is the deposited count matrix (raw_data_location raw.X); values are integer counts (float32 storage) and were summed per donor in the linear space before any test. GENOTYPE SPLIT: obs Primary.Genetic.Diagnosis values are 'control' (18 normals), 'PVneg' (8 DCM donors without a pathogenic variant) and 12 pathogenic-variant gene names (BAG3, DES, DSP, FKTN, FLNC, LMNA, PKP2, PLN, RBM20, TNNC1, TNNT2, TTN, TPM1); the split is genotype-first as ADR 0066 requires, so the 8 DCM/PVneg donors are the nHF cases, the 44 genotype-positive DCM donors plus the 8 ARVC donors are the ticket-188 export, and the single NCCM donor (H84, TPM1) is excluded. H29 is disease-labelled ARVC with an LMNA genotype; it is kept in the ARVC export by its disease label and not used for nHF. ARMS: the object's 'assay' field is confounded with cohort (10x 3' v2 vs v3), so no assay term is fitted; this is declared rather than corrected. ALIGNMENT: native 32,383 features are Ensembl ids without version; 18,085 resolve to the frozen axis by the ticket-01 precedence (canonical symbol, then Ensembl); unresolved native features are recorded in the summary, never guessed. The object's controls are the same H-series normal donors as the dropped myocarditis object (declared shared_control_group reichart-cm:normal; the myocarditis object is not ingested). GENETIC_CARDIOMYOPATHY DERIVATION (#188, additive): script/build_genetic_deg.py re-runs the same live implementation over the tracked pseudobulk + genotype export (read-only, no pseudobulk re-derivation) with design ~0 + group over the 78 donors and publishes the dcm_genotype_positive-normal (44 vs 18) and arvc-normal (8 vs 18) contrasts into local/deg/reichart-cm_genetic_deg.csv + tracked .json; #187's local/deg/reichart-cm_deg.* bytes and this item's source/ + manifest are unchanged. DEG: one joint limma-voom fit over 78 donors, design ~0 + status (normal / genotype-negative DCM / genotype-positive DCM / ARVC); only the genotype-negative DCM vs normal contrast publishes a DEG (17,513 tested genes, n_case 8, n_control 18). The pinned arc R env ships limma but not edgeR, so voom's own total-count library-size normalisation is used and TMM is deliberately not re-implemented. BUILD: capped at 10 GiB RLIMIT_AS, OMP_NUM_THREADS=2; pseudobulk peak RSS 870,940 KiB (~851 MiB), wall 22.9 s (675,760,435 raw/X nonzeros streamed in 4,000-cell chunks); DEG peak RSS 221,160 KiB, wall 2.3 s. R/limma recorded in local/deg/reichart-cm_deg.json and local/deg/reichart-cm_genetic_deg.json. GENETIC FIT BUILD: capped at 10 GiB RLIMIT_AS, OMP_NUM_THREADS=2; peak RSS 222,920 KiB (~218 MiB), wall 2.3 s (35,026 rows, 17,513 genes x 2 contrasts). REPRODUCTION: script/fetch.sh -> script/verify.sh -> script/build_pseudobulk.py -> script/build_deg.py; the tracked pseudobulk digest is recorded in the summary and the genotype table digest too.
